title: Send a fax (Fax for Agents)
description: One fax through the Fax for Agents API. Pass exactly one of fileUrl, text or markdown. A test key (ffa_test_...) reaches the sandbox only and costs nothing; +15550000001 is delivered there.

apiKey.title: Fax for Agents API key
apiKey.description: ffa_test_... reaches the sandbox only. ffa_live_... reaches the carrier and spends the prepaid wallet. Keys are created at app.faxforagents.com. Leave it empty and the run only checks that the API is reachable, sends nothing and writes one check record.

to.title: To
to.description: The destination fax number in E.164, for example +12025550123.

text.title: Text
text.description: Plain text rendered to a letter PDF. Pass this, markdown or fileUrl, not two.

markdown.title: Markdown
markdown.description: Markdown (headings, lists, emphasis, code) rendered to PDF.

fileUrl.title: File URL
fileUrl.description: A URL of a PDF, PNG, JPG or TIFF the Actor downloads and sends. Up to 25 MiB.

coverSubject.title: Cover sheet subject
coverSubject.description: Any cover field adds a billable cover page in front of the document.

coverMessage.title: Cover sheet message
coverMessage.description: A short message on the cover sheet.

coverToName.title: Cover sheet, to name
coverToName.description: The recipient name on the cover sheet.

coverFromName.title: Cover sheet, from name
coverFromName.description: The sender name on the cover sheet.

approvalId.title: Approval id
approvalId.description: An approved request bound to this send (apr_...), when the account needs a human approval for live sends.

clientReference.title: Client reference
clientReference.description: Your own reference stored on the fax, up to 200 characters. Defaults to the Apify run id.

waitForDelivery.title: Wait for delivery
waitForDelivery.description: Poll until the fax is delivered, partial, failed or unknown. Off returns once the fax is queued.

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for a terminal state before the run fails.

failOn.title: Fail the run on
failOn.description: Comma-separated terminal states that fail the run. Empty never fails the run.

baseUrl.title: API base URL
baseUrl.description: Only change it to point the Actor at a test double.
